title: Space usage after halting
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input, and let $w,w'$ be choice words. If the run from $c$ under $w$ has empty state, then the space used under the concatenated choice word $ww'$ from $c$ equals the space used under $w$ from $c$.
